description: 48 steps at an anvil placed across the player's way: a worn iron pickaxe repaired by three ingots, two pickaxes combined, Efficiency I and a book of it made Efficiency II, names typed and kept for the next items (a blank one removing a name, one too long ignored, a section sign removed), renaming alone capped at 39 levels with prior work penalties, a repair too expensive at 41, a result refused with too few levels and taken with enough, then /xp adding and setting levels and points (the total wrapping at the largest int); Circuit and both official servers give identical windows, costs, components, levels, progress and totals
